title: All About Slugs
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — non-fiction, real facts about slugs.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — non-fiction, real facts about slugs.

pages.text: A slug sits on a leaf.
pages.illustration: A small grey-brown garden slug resting on top of a green leaf, close-up view.
A close-up of the slug showing its soft, bare body with no shell on its back.

pages.text: A slug is soft and wet.
pages.illustration: The slug glistening with a thin layer of wet slime along its body.

pages.text: A slug makes a wet, bright trail.
pages.illustration: A shiny, wet trail left behind on the leaf where the slug has moved.

pages.text: A slug goes bit by bit.
pages.illustration: The slug stretching slowly forward along a stem, one small movement at a time.

pages.text: A slug eats a soft green leaf.
pages.illustration: The slug nibbling at the edge of a soft green leaf.

pages.text: A slug hides in the day.
pages.illustration: The slug tucked under a damp stone in dappled shade, hidden from the bright sun.

pages.text: Moss spots a slug in the long grass.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog peering down at the slug among tall blades of long grass.

pages.text: Moss looks at the wet trail.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog looking closely at the shiny trail left on a leaf near the slug.
Moss the hedgehog smiling, with the slug resting on a leaf beside him.
